topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I just can't believe this is happening. After all the planning, all the double-checking, my flight is delayed. Not by a little, but by hours. I look at my phone, the email from the airline confirming what I already know. I stare at the crowded airport, people rushing around, and I realize I’m not going to make it. The event, one I’ve been looking forward to for months, is slipping away. I have to tell them, explain somehow, that it’s out of my hands. It’s like a bad dream where you’re running but not getting anywhere. I need to keep it together, figure out my next move, but it’s hard when everything feels so off-kilter right now.
